Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Contemporary Office Desk Chair, 33"-36", Grey/Chrome
Colors: Grey/Chrome
Materials: Metal
With both height and tilt adjustments along with 360 degree swivel, this chair is functional and comfortable. The classic grey upholstery is paired with a metal base on casters, for a look that blends with modern or industrial decor. 22.6"W x 24"D x 33"-36"H Poplar, eucalyptus, iron base, and polyester fabric Mid-century minimalist, retro style 360 degree swivel function; height and tilt of chair can be adjusted Assembly in 15 minutes or less; simply screw on seat and casters Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
